Probe: native balance gas*maxFee+1 with a 5e12 L1 fee was signed and handed off; op-geth refuses it, so the lock jams until a top-up plus re-sign, and relayed signing for the address stays disarmed in the tab.

review_issues.problem: Re-sign is offered for 'submitted' locks without a fee bump. review_issues.suggestion: Bump maxFeePerGas and tip by at least 10 % over the replaced tx (this needs its fees stored in the lock), or offer re-sign only for unknown-after-handoff and say so in the hint.

That is consensus MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE: a longer script fails when run and never enters the UTXO set, so no valid block spends one. (2) Gives the pages of one block a shared budget of 64 MiB (MAX_BLOCK_JSON = 4 x the 16 MiB response cap). Each page is read through min(16 MiB, what is left), so a page that would pass the budget is cancelled while it streams and no further page is requested. This bounds what is streamed (64 MiB) and kept, including padding in prevout scripts, asm, addresses or unknown fields. A private request() returns text and bytes read; text() and json() are unchanged. Doc comments say that real blocks need a fraction of the budget, and that a contrived valid block needing more is refused, as a page over 16 MiB already is.
